name: Philippines (individual income tax, graduated rates)
notes: Graduated rates under the TRAIN law (RA 10963) schedule that applies from 1 January 2023.
Income means taxable compensation or business income after exclusions (13th-month pay up to ₱90,000, mandatory SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG contributions).
The optional 8% flat rate for eligible self-employed individuals is not modelled.
